evaluated_phase: Phase 2A.2 — Attestation Integrity, Normative Calibration & Controlled Human-Review Pilot
verdict_rationale: Implementation invariants pass across all 15 schemas and 79 unit tests. The 40-item stratified human review pilot and IAA tooling are fully established. Production Gold dataset generation remains paused pending authentic native linguist review of the pilot queue.

morphosyntactic_foundations.criteria: Authoritative verbal and nominal declension paradigms covering standard Cholit BDSB forms and agreement invariants.
morphosyntactic_foundations.evidence: 14 inflectional paradigms in ontology/paradigms/; dedicated _conjugate_ho() with indicative 'হন' vs imperative 'হোন'; -ni perfective negation calibrated with standard দিইনি / নিইনি.
morphosyntactic_foundations.known_conflicts: Register variation in colloquial Dhaka speech (দেইনি / নেইনি / হোস).

construction_grammar_coverage.criteria: Formalized clause patterns covering canonical SOV, OSV topicalization, pro-drop, polar interrogatives, and complex predicates.
construction_grammar_coverage.evidence: 22 construction definitions in ontology/constructions/constructions.json and 8 complex predicates in ontology/complex_predicates/.
construction_grammar_coverage.known_conflicts: Theoretical debates on whether correlative clauses should be modeled as adjunction or parataxis.

differential_object_marking.criteria: Feature-sensitive case assignment distinguishing animacy, specificity, definiteness, and discourse prominence.
differential_object_marking.evidence: DOMEngine in src/blf/linguistics/dom.py correctly assigning bare Ø for non-specific human search and overt -ke for specific human.
differential_object_marking.known_conflicts: Source divergence on inanimate objects: normative grammars prefer bare Ø, while corpus usage and descriptive syntax attest overt -ke on demonstratives and topicalized inanimates (এটাকে, চিঠিটাকে).

conversational_pragmatics_and_deixis.criteria: Social deixis honorificity mapping, polyfunctional particles, and structured valency-based interrogative disambiguation.
conversational_pragmatics_and_deixis.evidence: PragmaticsEngine in src/blf/linguistics/pragmatics.py; 7 multi-sense particles in ontology/pragmatics/pragmatic_particles.json; verb valency lexicon.
conversational_pragmatics_and_deixis.known_conflicts: Digital nonstandard spelling habits conflating 'কি' and 'কী'.

semantic_frames_grounding.criteria: Semantic frame taxonomy covering core communicative domains, frame elements, and selectional restrictions.
semantic_frames_grounding.evidence: 24 frames in ontology/frames/core_frames.json calibrated to status SOURCE_GROUNDED.
semantic_frames_grounding.known_conflicts: FrameNet frame hierarchy alignment with Berkeley FrameNet vs Bangla-specific lexical frames.

empirical_attestation_layer.criteria: Empirical grounding with verifiable locators, clear distinction between record validity and external verification.
empirical_attestation_layer.evidence: 12 attestations in ontology/attestations/ audited and honestly classified as PROVISIONAL pending physical page scans or corpus split indexing.
empirical_attestation_layer.known_conflicts: Physical print copies of Azad (1984) and Thompson (2012) require manual physical verification.

human_review_infrastructure.criteria: Versioned human review schema, stratified review queue, and inter-annotator agreement evaluation tooling.

data_quality_and_invariants.criteria: Enforcement of tri-tier isolation (GOLD/SILVER/SYNTHETIC), provenance graph completeness, and zero broken links.
data_quality_and_invariants.evidence: validate_provenance_graph.py passes with 0 broken links; validate_all.py passes 10/10 suites.

anti_ai_slop_and_documentation.criteria: Compliance with research writing policy; zero rhetoric padding; removal of ungrounded certainty claims.
anti_ai_slop_and_documentation.evidence: check_anti_slop.py passes across all documentation and research files.

gold_seed_entry_conditions: Native linguists complete independent review of the 40-item pilot queue (data/review_queue/human_review_pilot_40.json).
Inter-annotator agreement is computed and items with disagreement are adjudicated via scripts/compute_iaa.py.
Physical page audits for bibliographic citations in ontology/attestations/ are conducted to elevate PROVISIONAL attestations to TEXT_VERIFIED.
Source conflict on inanimate DOM is reviewed by annotators to establish guidelines for Gold sentences.
